oracle.source: Installed Codex app.asar, read-only; native pure thread renderer and palette plus SDK serialization with an in-memory RPC sink

limitations: Synthetic models only; no verified current session roster or live status source.
No rgbcfg keys/ambient, voice-state, inactivity or selection-visibility timer parity established.
No hardware rendering, transport ownership, recovery latency or firmware animation phase tested.
Missing selected/pulsing flags are intentionally rejected, although native code treats omitted pulsing as false.
A complete model and matched renderer do not establish source attribution, freshness or permission to write.
Source hashes pin these results to the inspected app build; updates require revalidation.
